mindshare.definition: Share of the attention observed across one measurement universe: 24h transactions, 24h volume and DexScreener boost spend, each as a share of the universe total, averaged over the components that resolved. It is on-chain and paid attention, not social mentions.
mindshare.caveat: The universe is whatever the collector polled -- tokens reach it by being boosted or profiled on DexScreener -- so it is a biased sample and shares from different universes are not comparable. Weighted 0.00 in the composite: it is collected and scored, but no prior was invented for it, and Phase 2 has not fitted one.

headline_warning: Phase 0 -- collection only. The scoring weights are uncalibrated priors: guesses. No edge has been measured, so nothing on this page is a prediction or a recommendation.

calibration.explanation: Phase 0 has not finished collecting, so there is nothing to calibrate. triggered=108 complete_social=0/300 dead_per_survivor=n/a (no survivors yet)/20 -> NOT met, keep collecting. Until this is met, every score the screener emits is an uncalibrated prior and must not be read as a prediction.

published_base_rates.note: Graduation is roughly a $69k market cap, and most graduates still round to zero. The screener's job is to beat a ~2% base rate, not to find winners.

trigger.rule: Every token is snapshotted once, the first time it crosses $250k market cap or 500 holders. The same rule applies to every token: the sample is lifecycle-matched by construction.
